notes.title: Hydra Slayer v18.3
notes.content: Yet another bugfix update! Fixed the bug with help not displaying, crash when examining shadow hydras, and lacking music (due to the lack of a DLL file).

notes.title: Hydra Slayer updated to 18.2!
notes.content: Another bugfix update. This fixes Titans not using up items correctly, Atlantean achievements, and the Resurrection achievement triggered with Twins. Have fun!

notes.title: Hydra Slayer updated to 18.1!
notes.content: This is mostly a bugfix update. It uses a newer version of the NotEye engine. It should fix the problem with mouse clicks not targetting the correct tile, some bugs with mini-map, and other minor bugs. Have fun!

notes.title: font rendering issue on Linux
notes.content: A small update should fix the font rendering issue on Linux.

notes.title: Leaderboards fixed
notes.content:
Update 18.0a fixes a problem which prevented some high scores from being uploaded to Steam. The bug affected most of the games with very good scores, and thus the leaderboards looked as if mostly nobody has ever beaten the second boss. View your local scores ("View achievements and the Hall of Fame" in the menu) to send them to Steam. Unfortunately, your local scores will not be uploaded to the "no potions of life" leaderboards if you later used a Potion of Life in the given game.

Also share your game logs or strategies on the forum! http://steamcommunity.com/app/432380/discussions/0/371918937262956260/

notes.title: Hydra Slayer 18.0 is released!
notes.content:
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=798144393

This release introduces a new playable character race (Atlantean), a new type of special hydra (evolving hydra), a new type of equipment, makes special hydras appear more frequently, and introduces many other improvements and bugfixes.

Read more on the blog: http://zenorogue.blogspot.com/2016/11/hydra-slayer-180.html

Have fun!

notes.title: HyperRogue 8.2 is released!
notes.content:
Quite a long time from the last update, but it is quite a big one!

It includes two new lands (Warped Coast and Rose Garden), one new Crossroads variant, two new gameplay modes (Heptagonal and Chaos), one new graphical mode (Hypersian Rug mode), 11 new achievements, and some other improvements. See http://zenorogue.blogspot.com/2016/03/hyperrogue-82.html for details!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/432380

Also, [b]Hydra Slayer[/b] is coming soon to Steam! Both HyperRogue and Hydra Slayer are roguelikes based on mathematical concepts from the same author, yet they are different at the same time -- while the world of HyperRogue is very open, in Hydra Slayer you descend a dungeon, where your resources are limited, and you have to find out how to use them most effectively. While HyperRogue is based on its unique geometry, Hydra Slayer is based on its unique math-based combat system (although there is some interesting geometry too). There are already some extra features over the free version of Hydra Slayer (like the random challenges), and hopefully, like HyperRogue, there will be more and more! Have fun, and thanks to everyone who voted for Hydra Slayer on Steam Greenlight!
